# The Elvish Age and the Hybrian Crash — Narrative Script

*Audio: 16_The_Elvish_Age_and_the_Hybrian_Crash.mp3 — August 2, 2026*

---

While the dwarves' forges went cold, the forests were waking up.

The elves had never depended on mines. Their culture was nature-attuned — gardens, mazes, living art — and in the poverty that followed the Romanium collapse, that made them the most prosperous people on Ge'or. Elvengar expanded from the continent of Kutten, reaching across the seas to conquer parts of the Demon Continent and West Erisdar. The Elvish Age had begun. The world's most beautiful cities were elven cities. The world's longest memories were elven memories. For fifteen centuries, Ge'or belonged to the pointed ears.

But in 2989 BGD, something fell from the sky.

A Hybrian ship crashed in Pontus — the first Shadow presence on the planet in fifteen thousand years. The crash triggered human invasions that pushed the elves back, wave after wave, until Elvengar's empire shrank to its Kutten homeland. The elves could not be mind-read; they could not be turned; they were the one species the Shadows could not control. That is why the Shadows hunted them. That is why they engineered everything that followed.

The Elvish Age ended on the day the ship fell.

What came next would be engineered from the shadows — for centuries, in silence, until the elves' own golden age was a memory used against them.
